claims.text: Toolbar
claims.note: The button is in the main Spatial Adjust toolbar, to the right of the pushed-today counter.

claims.text: When a scan is not current, what you see depends on the calculation option.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (request-scan-data/before/1); docs/text-corrections.md §25 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: When a scan is not current the calculation still runs — it runs on a modelled value carried forward from the last scan and the weather since, shown in grey italics.

claims.text: Under Option 2 the calculation still runs, on a value modelled forward from the last scan and the weather since, and the reading is shown in grey italics with a calculator icon.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (request-scan-data/before/1); docs/text-corrections.md §25 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (request-scan-data/before/1); docs/text-corrections.md §25 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: Read the scan date before anything else
claims.note: The scan date is on every station row.

claims.text: Every station row carries the date its reading was captured.
claims.note: Station rows show lastScan in small grey type beside the name. A paired row shows the newest date in the pair (sa-dash-table.component.ts:391-396). Area and hole rows show a date in a column of their own (sa-table-card.component.html:36).

claims.text: One stale row is a station; a column of stale dates is the whole course, and that is a supply problem rather than a settings problem.
claims.note: The dates are TurfRad's recorded scan dates (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2999), which no setting changes. Requesting scan data helps only if TurfRad holds something newer (see request-scan-data/tile/2).

claims.text: Scan dates sit beside the station name in the table.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Request the latest scan
claims.note: The request is made from the toolbar button.

claims.text: The circular-arrow button in the toolbar’s right-hand group is Request latest scan data.
claims.note: The icon is Font Awesome "sync" (two circular arrows), which spins while a request is outstanding (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:57). The tooltip is SPATIAL_ADJUST.REQUEST_SCAN_DATA through the titlecase pipe, so it shows "Request Latest Scan Data". The button's text label is not displayed (sa-main-toolbar.component.less:163-165) and carries the Settings string, not the scan string (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:58).

claims.text: It asks Spatial Adjust to fetch the latest scan data TurfRad already holds, ahead of the next automatic retrieval.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (request-scan-data/2/3); docs/text-corrections.md §22 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: It asks TurfRad for a new scan; it does not reload the dashboard, and it does not change a single calculation setting.

claims.text: It does not order a new scan, it does not reload the dashboard, and it does not change a single calculation setting.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (request-scan-data/2/3); docs/text-corrections.md §22 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: Request latest scan data, between the pushed-today counter and the gear.
claims.note: Figure caption. From the counter the order is: separator, this button, the Announcements bullhorn, the Settings gear. The bullhorn also sits between this button and the gear (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:62-65).

claims.text: Note. This button and Reload Data are two different things.
claims.note: The scan button is in the toolbar. Reload Data appears only on the banner.

claims.text: One asks for new data; the other brings data that has already arrived into the page.
claims.note: "New data" means whatever TurfRad holds that Spatial Adjust has not yet retrieved. Reload Data re-fetches the dashboard's data from the server.

claims.text: It queues, it does not block
claims.note: The endpoint returns 202 Accepted, and the server starts the retrieval without waiting for it.

claims.text: The request is queued and you are told so: retrieval may take several minutes, and you are notified when it is ready.
claims.note: The toast reads "Request Queued", then "Retrieval may take several minutes. We'll notify you when it's ready." The notification is the banner, which appears only if the dashboard is still open when the retrieval finishes (see request-scan-data/3/3).

claims.text: You can carry on reading the table while it runs — nothing is frozen and nothing is lost if you navigate away.
claims.note: Only the button changes while the request runs: it dims and its icon spins (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:52, :57). The retrieval runs on the server and finishes whether or not the page is open, so no data is lost. The banner does depend on the open page. It appears only if the toolbar that made the request is still loaded when the completion signal arrives (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:207-213). After navigating away no banner comes, and the retrieved data loads the next time the dashboard loads its data (sa-dashboard.component.ts:388).

claims.text: A queued request confirms immediately; the data arrives later.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Reload when the banner appears
claims.note: The banner carries the Reload Data button.

claims.text: When the retrieval finishes, a banner says so, whether or not TurfRad had a newer scan.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (request-scan-data/4/2); docs/text-corrections.md §22 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: When the scan lands, a banner says so.

claims.text: Reload Data pulls it into the dashboard and every suggestion recalculates against the new readings.
claims.note: Reload Data re-fetches all of the dashboard's data (sa-dashboard.component.ts:280-286), and each suggestion is recalculated as the data loads (:597). If TurfRad had nothing newer, the numbers come back unchanged (see request-scan-data/4/2).

claims.text: Dismiss closes the banner and leaves you on the data you already had — the new scan is not thrown away, it is simply not loaded yet.
claims.note: Dismiss only hides the banner. The retrieved data is already stored on the server (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2112), so nothing is thrown away.

claims.text: The banner offers Reload Data or Dismiss.
claims.note: Figure caption. The buttons are "Reload Data" (SPATIAL_ADJUST.RELOAD_DATA) and "Dismiss" (SPATIAL_ADJUST.DISMISS).

claims.text: Careful. Dismissing is not declining.
claims.note: Dismiss has no effect on the data.

claims.text: The next reload picks the new scan up.
claims.note: After Dismiss there is no Reload Data button until the next request. The data is picked up whenever the dashboard loads its data again: opening or refreshing the page, saving a settings change, or changing station factors (sa-dashboard.component.ts:262-278).

claims.text: If the request will not queue
claims.note: A failure to queue has its own error branch.

claims.text: A failed request says so straight away rather than silently doing nothing.
claims.note: A failed request at once shows "Request Failed" with "Unable to queue the scan data request. Please try again."

claims.text: If it keeps failing, the diagnostics dialog reports whether the organisation has TurfRad access and whether it has scan data at all — a course-wide problem is almost always there rather than in your settings.
claims.note: The TurfRad panel lists "TR org ID:", "TR selected course ID:", "SA has org access:", "Org has scan data:" and "Last scan date:" (sa-diagnostics-dlg.component.html:17-41). They are checked live when the dialog opens (sa-diagnostics-dlg.component.ts:61-89). These explain a course whose scans never arrive. They do not explain a request that will not queue: the server fails the request only when the site has no Spatial Adjust update record (SpatialAdjustService.cs:985-990) or the call itself fails, and Diagnostics shows neither. The Diagnostics dialog opens only on a Shift+Alt click on the Spatial Adjust logo, and only once a Lynx course is loaded or Lynx has failed to load (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:4, sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:293-299). No guide step says how to open it. Its labels are hard-coded English (sa-diagnostics-dlg.component.html:22-89).
